# a2.games

> Lightweight, open-source browser games focused on accessibility, instant play and minimal friction. No installs or sign-ups.

## About

a2.games is part of the A2 Ventures portfolio (https://a2ventures.group), an independent venture studio run by Raghu Chinnannan.
